items.title: Amazon Bedrock expands API support and introduces Cross-Region Inferencing for OpenAI models in AWS GovCloud (US)

Amazon CloudFront now provides viewer ISP and post-quantum TLS details
Amazon RDS for Oracle no longer requires automatic minor version upgrades for JVM, Spatial, Locator, and OLAP options
AWS WAF announces automatic SDK integration for Amazon CloudFront distributions
AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports Apache Iceberg table optimization in the US West (N. California) Region
Amazon SageMaker AI inference now supports GPU partitioning for real-time endpoints
Amazon RDS for Oracle and SQL Server now support storage autoscaling on additional storage volumes
Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is now available in additional Regions
Amazon Redshift announces hands-off automated cross-region backups
